name: Start with Interval 100: done; nothing at 99 ms; Tick and Count 1 at 100
because: repeat.ts :118-128 the first tick is due one interval after the last frame; timerscheduler.ts :177-197 the queued timer joins at the next frame, :132-159 finishes when the frame's time reaches start + duration

name: the beat keeps its phase: ticks at 100, 200 and 300 across three advances of 100
because: repeat.ts :186-193 the next due time is the last one plus the beat, and the timer is re-queued from onFinish

name: a tick due during a long advance fires ONCE at the next frame; the missed beats are skipped, not replayed, and the beat keeps its phase (350 → next at 400)
because: repeat.ts :188-191 — ceil((now − nextAt) / beat + EPSILON) whole beats are skipped; GAM-013's 'no catch-up burst'

name: Start while running reports unchanged; Stop reports done and no Tick follows; Stop again is unchanged
Count keeps its value after Stop and goes back to 0 on the next Start — sent then, before the new ticks
because: repeat.ts :132 'Count keeps its value until the next Start'; :123-126 reset only when it was not 0

name: an Interval that is the text '100', 0, −5 or NaN fails Start with repeat/interval-not-positive and nothing runs; 0.5 is usable
because: repeat.ts :40-42 isUsableInterval — a number, finite, above zero; :111-117

name: an Interval changed while running takes effect from the next tick (100 then 50); an unusable one keeps the last beat
because: repeat.ts :186 `if (isUsableInterval(interval)) beat = interval` at every tick

name: the first tick is due from the LAST FRAME's time, not the clock: a Start after an advance with no settle between joins at 500 and ticks at 600, then skips forward to 700
because: repeat.ts :36-38 frameTimeOf reads currentFrameTime, the time of the frame most recently run; :120-122; :188-191 the skip

name: two Starts in one frame: the second is unchanged (the node's own flag, not the scheduler's)
because: repeat.ts :22-24 'no stacking' — unlike Delay's guard on _isRunning

name: Stop before the first frame cancels the queued timer: done, and no Tick ever
because: timerscheduler.ts :108-113 stopTimer removes a queued timer from newTimers
